user.title: Btechnics IOT
user.description: Installs the Btechnics IOT branding. Configure the texts via the gear icon after installation.

init.title: Btechnics IOT settings

data.customer_logo: Upload customer logo (png, jpg, svg, webp)
data.customer_logo_scale: Customer logo size (% of the Btechnics logo)
data.status_url: Address for the status to Btechnics
data.status_token: Key of this customer (from the Work app)

init.description:
Current customer logo: {customer_logo_status}

Status to Btechnics: fill in the key of this customer. Without a key nothing is sent.

error.invalid_logo: File is not a valid image (png, jpg, svg, webp or gif).
error.status_url_https: The address must start with https://.

hooks_broken.title: Btechnics IOT: branding partly inactive after update
hooks_broken.description:
After updating to version {ha_version} these parts of the Btechnics IOT branding no longer work: {problems}.

The system itself keeps working; the original logo or name may be visible in those places. Update Btechnics IOT Features via HACS once a new version is available, or contact Btechnics.

update_failed.title: Update {name} fails to install automatically
update_failed.description:
The automatic update of {name} to version {version} failed {attempts} times. It will no longer be retried automatically and is visible again under Settings.

Install it manually or contact Btechnics. When a newer version is released, automatic updates will try again.

run_updates.name: Run updates now
run_updates.description: Installs available updates now, following the Btechnics IOT settings.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Show what would be installed without doing anything.

send_status.name: Send status to Btechnics
send_status.description: Sends the status of this installation to Btechnics right away and shows what was sent.
